title: Lingering Smell of Onions ...
text:
Lingering Smell of Onions .... I Love these for their sanitary aspect -- one piece construction.
I Hate the fact they still Smell of the onions I cooked weeks ago. So sad.

product_metadata.title: StarPack Basics Silicone Spatula Set (2 Small, 2 Large), High Heat Resistant to 480°F, Hygienic One Piece Design, Non Stick Rubber Cooking Utensil Set (Cherry Red)

VERSATILE AND ESSENTIAL HEAT RESISTANT SPATULA SET - Contains: 2 x Large Kitchen Spatulas for Cooking: 11.5" x 2.2" & 2 x Small Heat Resistant Spatula : 8.5" x 1.6"
